name: com.highperfui.runtime
description: A Unity UGUI runtime focused on lazy fragments, incremental state commits, frame-budgeted scheduling, safe pooling, async binding guards and fixed-height list virtualization.

samples.description: Self-contained 2000-item list. Attach MinimalIntegrationDemo in an empty scene.
Example wiring for a large reward list using virtualization, pooling, dirty-state commits and async sprite guards.
Playable equipment, upgrades and mixed rewards, with opt-in A/B/C diagnostics. Runtime has no dependency on this sample.
